Native recording and playback failures are ordinary Errors. The voice interaction boundary maps them to cataloged failure state rather than displaying these exception messages. This classification does not certify microphone-permission UX or physical audio acceptance.

OnboardingScreen delegates typed partial-success failures and other errors to onboardingError; the presentation catalog supplies both recovery context and guidance. Application messages are not rendered directly.
English literals match application errors to catalog keys; they are not returned as display text.

strings: Unsupported asset checkout action.
reason: The remaining English literal rejects invalid command identifiers. Supported checkout, return, details and undo availability errors use catalog messages.

strings: Discovery cancelled.
reason: Cancellation control flow is suppressed by query/task lifecycle handling; discovery and selection failures now use catalog guidance.
Runtime configuration exceptions feed auth failure categories or callback recovery; startup and callback surfaces render cataloged guidance rather than raw configuration errors.
Sign-in exceptions are handled by the sign-in and callback presentation paths. The OIDC scope string is protocol data, not UI copy.
Local incomplete-pagination errors are ordinary Error values, not safeForUser messages. NotificationInbox replaces them with cataloged load recovery through safeWorkspaceErrorMessage.
Local batch validation errors are ordinary Error values. NotificationInbox supplies cataloged mark-all recovery; these diagnostics do not define rendered notification labels.
